title: stream4
summary: A Python data-processing pipeline (step2.py, step3.py, app.py) that oversamples imbalanced tabular data, synthesizes additional records, and evaluates the synthetic output against the real data. It runs SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, Metadata and evaluate_quality functions for synthesis and quality assessment, and imports RDT's ClusterBasedNormalizer and OneHotEncoder transformers directly for preprocessing.
